propositions: Packaged prose guides cite criterion IDs inline but have no mechanism coupling those citations to the authoritative criteria registry, allowing criterion text to change without triggering a gate failure or forcing guide re-verification.

A citation-pin manifest (criterion-pins.json) should be generated and validated in CI to detect when a cited criterion's text diverges from the guide's claim about it, converting silent semantic drift into a visible, forced re-verification.

The pin gate must extract criterion citations from guides using vocabulary-only matching (word-boundary matching against CANONICAL_LLM, no markup dependence) to avoid false positives from ordinary prose edits and reordering.
The gate must report four classes of failure: unknown citation (ID absent from registry), stale pin (criterion text changed), orphan pin (ID no longer cited), and missing manifest (file absent).

The new guide_parity.py module and its tests must cover all guides in AUTHOR_GUIDES, run in CI by composition into validate-routing without a new workflow step, and leave all src/rebar files under the 800-LOC module-size cap.
